label: A major volcano going off on the west coast
description: Seen 12 September 2025: a major volcano erupting on the American west coast. He notes that the Lord permits him to say this because it is a natural event, which is a stated rule about what he is allowed to name.
aliases: west coast I saw a major volcano

label: A wave of anti-gun legislation in blue states
description: Given 10 September 2025, the day of the Kirk killing: the disarming of the Second Amendment pushed in blue states through a wave of anti-gun legislation, with the Lord saying they will see more of it in the days ahead. State legislative activity is a matter of public record.

label: Rome and the Vatican shaking, with structural damage
description: Seen 13 September 2025: Rome shaking and the Vatican shaking, with structural damage to the Vatican specified, then transferring and trickling into Germany. Structural damage is a reportable threshold, which is unusual in this material.
